name: io.github.diy-accounting-uk/diya-submit
title: DIY Accounting Submit
description: Opens a book, derives VAT return figures and reads stored VAT receipts. Files no return.

tools.name: list_books
tools.description: List the books saved in the DIYA cloud, most recently updated first, signed in as the session's credentials. Each row carries the bookId open_book takes, the book's title, its product and the period it covers. With clientId, lists that practice client's books instead of the practice's own.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to list that client's books instead of the practice's own

tools.name: open_book
tools.description: Open a book saved in the DIYA cloud by bookId (a practice client's own book with clientId), signed in as the caller. Answers the product, the entity, the period covered, the line count and the book checks summary. Replaces the session's loaded book.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to open that client's book instead of the practice's own

tools.name: derive_vat_return
tools.description: The nine VAT boxes for one obligation period from the session's loaded book, read from the engine's own VAT interface: the quarter ending on periodEnd (a month end the book carries), with HMRC's field names and rounding, the three months' figures, and every sales and purchases journal line that fed boxes 1, 4, 6 and 7. Refuses a book that is not VAT registered, a period the book does not carry, and a period whose lines do not reconcile with the interface.

periodEnd.description: The obligation's period end, YYYY-MM-DD; must be a month end the book's VAT interface carries

periodStart.description: The obligation's period start, YYYY-MM-DD; refused unless it opens the quarter ending periodEnd

periodKey.description: The obligation's period key, echoed back for the submit call

tools.name: prepare_vat_return
tools.description: Derives the VAT return for the quarter ending on periodEnd from the session's loaded book, exactly as derive_vat_return does, and answers a link to the VAT form on the Submit site with the seven figures filled in (the form works out boxes 3 and 5 itself). This tool never files anything and reaches no outside service. The person opens the link, checks the figures on the page, ticks the declaration and files there; the figures filed are the figures the page shows.

periodEnd.description: The obligation's period end, YYYY-MM-DD; must be a month end the book's VAT interface carries

periodStart.description: The obligation's period start, YYYY-MM-DD; refused unless it opens the quarter ending periodEnd

tools.name: get_vat_receipt
tools.description: A stored VAT return receipt by its file name, over the deployed API: what HMRC answered when it accepted the return (the processing date, the form bundle number, the payment indicator and the charge reference). clientId, when given, narrows the fetch to one of the practice's clients but does not change which receipt is read.

name.description: The receipt file name, including .json (submit_vat_return answers receiptId without the suffix)

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to check the receipt belongs to that client

tools.name: list_vat_receipts
tools.description: The VAT return receipts Submit has stored for the signed-in account, newest first: each row carries the name get_vat_receipt takes, HMRC's form bundle number and the day the return was filed. clientId narrows the list to one of the practice's clients.

clientId.description: A practice client's id, to list that client's receipts
